column3: racaya kucayoḥ patram citram kuruṣva kapolayoḥ ghaṭaya jaghane kāñcīm añca srajā kavarībharam |
kalaya valayaśreṇīm pāṇau pade kuru nūpurau iti nigaditaḥ prītaḥ pītāmbaraḥ api tathā akarot ||
yat gāndharvakalāsu kauśalam anudhyānam ca yat vaiṣṇavam yat śṛṅgāravivekatattvam api yat kāvyeṣu līlāyitam |
tat sarvam jayadevapaṇḍitakaveḥ kṛṣṇaikatānātmanaḥ sānandāḥ pariśodhayantu sudhiyaḥ śrīgītagovindataḥ ||
